title: CVD-2D 科学数据契约 / CVD-2D Scientific Data Contract

run_revision.correction: new revision with supersedes_revision_id and correction_reason
run_revision.sample_provenance: append-only SampleRevisionAssociation snapshot per locked revision

ambient_measurements.not_measured: store an explicit source_type without value, time, or sensor

source_load.ingredients: one or more MaterialLot version references
source_load.parameter_template_status: internal_validation; pelletize and other minimum templates remain pending real-run trial confirmation

preparation_operations.legacy_read: old leak_check becomes named other; absent exchange_mode remains unspecified, never inferred from cycle_count
preparation_operations.duration_basis: total duration of the operation, not per cycle
preparation_operations.gas_source_identity: frozen MaterialLot gas-cylinder version; one premixed cylinder is one source, while on-site mixing references each physical cylinder

temperature_program.cooling: programmed cooling uses the same temperature steps; rates are derived per descending segment and remain setpoint values

process_timeline.duration: process_duration_min is explicitly entered once; whole_process spans zero to this endpoint, including recorded cooling; legacy records without it remain unspecified

gas_supply.identity: physical cylinder lot and version; premixed is a supply category, not a chemical species
gas_supply.premixed: reference the commercial cylinder composition and record its total flow once; on-site mixing references separate cylinders
gas_supply.raw_readings: retain original values and units; never convert mL/min or L/min to sccm without calibration and reference conditions
gas_supply.value_source: MFC setpoints use setpoint; float-meter readings use measured; old source types are preserved until explicitly changed

pressure_conditions.reference: prevailing ambient atmospheric pressure; do not assume an exact ambient pressure or universal 80000 Pa boundary
pressure_conditions.legacy_read: ultra_high_vacuum maps to low_pressure without changing raw historical revisions

process_timeline.cooling_sequence: staged_cooling expands an ordered list of methods; programmed segments reference temperature steps, never a single average cooling rate

process_event.option_order: supply interruptions → line/pressure deviations → equipment/signals → plan changes → other
process_event.plan_changed: includes manual intervention and manual stop; reuse intervention actions and outcome without adding required fields
process_event.legacy_read: merge legacy manual types into plan_changed, preserve original type labels in description; never rewrite immutable revisions

characterization_entry.policy: 只保留定义明确的采集参数与有文件依据的结果；legacy_only 仅从新录入表单移除，历史 API、详情与导出保留。
characterization_entry.deferred: 图像统计、粗糙度、元素定量、通用分析面板、统计与不确定度编辑器
characterization_entry.result_source: 峰参数、台阶高度与晶格间距填写对应数据文件中已有的结果，不自动推断统计方式。
characterization_entry.peak_entry: 不显示状态下拉；空白不生成峰结果，添加峰后自动记为 recorded，仅显式勾选未检出记为 not_detected；历史 not_analyzed 保留。

instrument_other_methods.validation: 非空字符串列表；每个名称去除首尾空白后长度 1–128，忽略大小写不得重复。
instrument_other_methods.history: 不改既有仪器版本；新建或新增版本选择其他时须填写名称。

scientific_contract.result_chain: Sample → MeasurementRun (instrument + calibration-at-measurement snapshot) → AnalysisRun → PropertyValue / MaterialAssertion

raman_e2g_peak_position.label_zh: Raman E₂g / E′ 代表峰位
raman_e2g_peak_position.label_en: Representative Raman E2g / E-prime peak position

raman_a1g_peak_position.label_zh: Raman A₁g / A₁′ 代表峰位
raman_a1g_peak_position.label_en: Representative Raman A1g / A1-prime peak position
